issue.title: CakePHP 3.3: Allow scoped filters (/w scoped pagination)

body: Does your issue happen outside of the search plugin context?

body:
The issue seems to have to do with `Router::build()` getting a mix of query string and query string params.

E.g.  from the book

``` php
// Generate a URL using a named route,
// with some query string args.
$url = Router::url(['_name' => 'login', 'username' => 'jimmy']);
```

http://book.cakephp.org/3.0/en/development/routing.html#using-named-routes

Now if request `/admin/flexi-core/languages/index/foo/bar/quux?Languages[sort]=code&Languages[direction]=asc&Languages[code]=da` and I run at the bottom of 3.next's `public function generateUrl(array $options = [], $model = null, $full = false) {` this debug:

``` php
        $return = $this->Url->build($url, $full);
        debug($url);
        debug($return);
        return $return;
```

I get back

``` php
[
    'Languages' => [
        'sort' => 'code',
        'direction' => 'desc',
        'order' => null
    ],
    (int) 0 => 'foo',
    (int) 1 => 'bar',
    (int) 2 => 'quux',
    '?' => [
        'Languages' => [
            'sort' => 'code',
            'direction' => 'asc',
            'code' => 'da'
        ]
    ]
]
```

`'/admin/flexi-core/languages/index/foo/bar/quux?Languages%5Bsort%5D=code&Languages%5Bdirection%5D=desc'`

However the router only respects:

```
    'Languages' => [
        'sort' => 'code',
        'direction' => 'desc',
        'order' => null
    ],
```

While this is being discarded

``` php
    '?' => [
        'Languages' => [
            'sort' => 'code',
            'direction' => 'asc',
            'code' => 'da'
        ]
    ]
```

@markstory **Could it be a bug around merging scoped query string parameters within the router?**

> Could it be a bug around merging scoped query string parameters within the router?

Could be. Perhaps there is a missing merge between the current scope and the `?` key?

I could narrow it down a bit more but got lost in `RouteCollection::match()`

If within `Router::url()`, I replace 

``` php
            $output = static::$_collection->match($url, static::$_requestContext + ['params' => $params]);
```

with

``` php
            $foo = false; if (isset($url['LanguagesScope']) || isset($url['Languages'])) { $foo = true; }
            if($foo) debug($params);
            if($foo) debug($url);
            $output = static::$_collection->match($url, static::$_requestContext + ['params' => $params]);
```

And request /admin/flexi-core/languages?Languages%5Bcode%5D=d%2A

These are the results 

### LanguagesScope = working

```
[
    'plugin' => 'FlexiCore',
    'controller' => 'Languages',
    'action' => 'index',
    '_ext' => null,
    'pass' => [],
    'prefix' => 'admin',
    '_matchedRoute' => '/admin/flexi-core/:controller',
    'isAjax' => false,
    'paging' => [
        'Languages' => [
            'finder' => 'all',
            'page' => (int) 1,
            'current' => (int) 2,
            'count' => (int) 2,
            'perPage' => (int) 20,
            'prevPage' => false,
            'nextPage' => false,
            'pageCount' => (int) 1,
            'sort' => null,
            'direction' => false,
            'limit' => null,
            'sortDefault' => false,
            'directionDefault' => false,
            'scope' => 'LanguagesScope'
        ]
    ]
]
```

```
[
    'LanguagesScope' => [
        'sort' => 'code',
        'direction' => 'asc',
        'order' => null
    ],
    '?' => [
        'Languages' => [
            'code' => 'd*'
        ]
    ],
    'action' => 'index',
    'prefix' => 'admin',
    'plugin' => 'FlexiCore',
    'controller' => 'Languages',
    '_ext' => null
]
```

### Languages = not working

```
[
    'plugin' => 'FlexiCore',
    'controller' => 'Languages',
    'action' => 'index',
    '_ext' => null,
    'pass' => [],
    'prefix' => 'admin',
    '_matchedRoute' => '/admin/flexi-core/:controller',
    'isAjax' => false,
    'paging' => [
        'Languages' => [
            'finder' => 'all',
            'page' => (int) 1,
            'current' => (int) 2,
            'count' => (int) 2,
            'perPage' => (int) 20,
            'prevPage' => false,
            'nextPage' => false,
            'pageCount' => (int) 1,
            'sort' => null,
            'direction' => false,
            'limit' => null,
            'sortDefault' => false,
            'directionDefault' => false,
            'scope' => 'Languages'
        ]
    ]
]
```

```

    'Languages' => [
        'sort' => 'code',
        'direction' => 'asc',
        'order' => null
    ],
    '?' => [
        'Languages' => [
            'code' => 'd*'
        ]
    ],
    'action' => 'index',
    'prefix' => 'admin',
    'plugin' => 'FlexiCore',
    'controller' => 'Languages',
    '_ext' => null
```

However for `LanguagesScope` the output of `static::$_collection->match($url, static::$_requestContext + ['params' => $params]);`still carries the filter param, whereas for `Languages` it does not.

In `RouteCollection::match()` I think somewhere in this block the difference is being created:

```
            foreach ($this->_routeTable[$name] as $route) {
                $match = $route->match($url, $context);
                if ($match) {
                    return strlen($match) > 1 ? trim($match, '/') : $match;
                }
            }
```

I got lost there.
The current workaround is using `LanguageScope` as a scope name to not collide with the filtering.
Couldn't the merge between the scoped query string, and the standard URL parameters be done in the PaginatorHelper?

@markstory 
1. I could, I tried and the tests went crazy.
2. Isn't still something wrong about `Router::url()` / `RouteCollection::match()` not merging named params (? or whatever those should be called, what are they called?=) and query string params into the query string?

So even if I find a way around 1. there is still a bug in 2.?

**Edit:** 

Interim Workaround: I am setting a prefix for friendsofcake/search like `CountriesFilter` and a scope/prefix for pagination like `CountriesPagination`.

Explicit query string parameters shouldn't be merged with the 'routing keys'. Merging the `?` into the routing keys could overwrite the routing keys. While merging routing keys into `?` will result in all routing keys being set as query string parameters.

I'm hoping to find time to look at this issue this week.
I was able to reproduce the issue tonight. I'll take a look into the cause and possible solution tomorrow.

issue.title: Fix scoped query parameters not being merged into pagination URLs

issue.body:
Existing query parameters in the active scope should be present in generated pagination URLs. This fixes pagination URLs 'dropping' scoped parameters.

Refs #9210
